title: Quiz Clamp All
prompt: A quiz chart must keep every score inside a visible range. Write a function that returns a new array where values below min become min and values above max become max.

explanation.beginner:
Example: quizClampAll([45,80,105], 50, 100) produces [50,80,100]. Apply both bounds so values inside the interval remain unchanged and outliers move to the nearest permitted bound.

Compare “keeps values inside the range”: input [[50,80],50,100] produces [50,80]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
